approved_payload.content: Thulani Mbana, the DA's ward 14 candidate and Metsimaholo caucus leader, was shot dead at his home in Taylor Park, Zamdela, Sasolburg, at about 21:40 on Monday 26 October, according to police. Police say two unknown men approached his residence and called out to him; when he went to them, one produced a firearm and shot him several times at close range, and both fled on foot. He died at the scene. A murder case is being investigated; the provincial commissioner activated the Zamdela Trio Task Team and the Serious Organised Crime Unit. Police say the motive has not been established and it has not been confirmed whether the killing was politically motivated. No arrests were reported. Sources: SAPS Free State statement and OFM News (Brig Thandi Mbambo), 27 October, and SABC News, 27 October (DA statement). The map point is the Zamdela suburb point, not his home.
